async function craftOneIronAxe(bot) {
    // This function attempts to create a single iron axe if one is not already present in the inventory. It first verifies that the bot possesses at least three iron ingots and two sticks. It then searches for a crafting table within a 32-block radius. If a crafting table is found, it proceeds to craft one iron axe. Finally, it confirms that the iron axe was successfully added to the inventory.
